_doc: Sunstone material classes: the id the shader switches on (mg_texTag[0].x) and the snippet that draws each class.
Ids are part of the tag table's format (mod/texture_tags.json): never renumber or reuse one; add new classes at the end.
Id 0 is 'untagged': the shader then picks a class from the material (materialMatrix), see tools/materials/README.md.
A class with no tools/materials/<name>.glsl yet is drawn by generic.glsl. Default parameters live in each snippet's
'// @default' line, so a class worker edits only their own snippet (and their rows in overrides.json).
